title: Strict Monotonicity of Numerical Invariants for the Submodules $[(z-w)^k]$ in $H^2(\mathbb D^2)$
summary: For $k\geq1$, let $M_k=[(z-w)^k]\subset H^2(\mathbb D^2)$. We first determine the banded Toeplitz matrices associated with the homogeneous components of $M_k$, together with explicit formulas for their determinants and the relevant algebraic cofactors. These formulas lead to a complete description of the spectrum of the core operator: \[ σ(C_{M_k}) = \{0,1\} \cup \left\{ \pm\frac{k}{n+k}:n\geq1 \right\}. \] In particular, the spectral data determine the parameter $k$.
